acceptedWorkstreams.title: A one-cohort case-study template with an evidence checklist and interviewer guide
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Build one fill-in-the-blank template a sales lead can hand to a bootcamp after its first cohort. It should capture the before state, what changed, the exact Zedu features used, one measurable result the customer can confirm, and a quote with written permission. Include a 15-minute interviewer guide and an evidence checklist that separates customer-confirmed facts from marketing claims. One task: write the template, guide and checklist, with a completed example using only clearly labelled placeholders. No invented customer, numbers or quotes.
